question: DRAG DROP A management system meeting ISO 45001:2018 requirements is based on the Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle. Match the four elements of the management system that are to the correct part of the PDCA cycle. Note: To complete the table, click on the space on the right of the relevant part of the PDCA cycle you want to complete so it is highlighted in red and then click on one of the four elements of the management system options below. Alternatively, drag and drop each of the elements to the appropriate part of the PDCA cycle.
